style: Molten riso poster art: a screen-printed volcanic field poster in flat, genuinely saturated molten orange (#FF5A1F) and sulfur yellow (#FFC21A) inks over warm brown basalt and ash-paper stock, hard-edged shapes, visible halftone dot shading, coarse paper tooth and deliberate ink misregistration, no photorealism, no neon glow, no smooth digital gradients.

items.name: bg_ash_sky
items.prompt: A screen-printed poster sky above a volcano at midday, built from flat stacked bands of pale cream, sulfur yellow and saturated orange with a bleached sun disc, visible halftone dots and coarse paper tooth, slight ink misregistration at every colour edge, no gradient smoother than a riso pull, empty lower third.

items.name: bg_rock_wall
items.prompt: A basalt strata wall seen head-on in warm orange and maroon printing inks, horizontal sedimentary bands with dry-brush edges crossing the frame, heavy paper grain and halftone shading, flat screen-print texture with no highlights and no glow.

items.name: bg_chamber_glow
items.prompt: A volcanic magma chamber seen in cross-section as a riso print, a molten pool of saturated orange and sulfur yellow bleeding upward into dark maroon rock, hard-edged colour separations, halftone dot shading and gritty paper texture, the upper two thirds dark rock.

items.name: bg_cast_result
items.prompt: A dark maroon basalt cavern interior as a screen print, a faint sulfur starburst of flat printed rays radiating from the centre across rough rock, halftone dot shading and heavy paper grain, hard-edged inks, empty centre for artwork.

items.name: tex_obsidian_facet
items.prompt: A flat-shaded volcanic glass surface in deep teal-black with a few pale mint conchoidal fracture facets cutting across it, crisp screen-printed edges and paper grain, no photographic reflections and no highlights.

items.name: tex_ash_grain
items.prompt: A dense even field of fine volcanic ash speckle and printing-press grain in warm grey on a flat pale ground, seamless all-over texture with no focal point and no objects.

items.name: hero_caldera_poster
items.prompt: A riso travel-poster portrait of one volcano in cross-section at midday, a black basalt cone against a sulfur yellow sky, a branching network of glowing molten orange veins threading up through the rock to three rim vents, flat inks, halftone grain and deliberate misregistration.

items.name: logo_title
items.prompt: Stylized game logo lettering reading "VolcVein" in heavy condensed uppercase, cream and sulfur-yellow letters with a molten orange misregistration ghost behind them, carved basalt shards and thin glowing magma veins curling around the letterforms as ornaments, flat screen-printed inks with halftone grain on a transparent background.

items.name: btn_primary
items.prompt: An ornate wide button plate shaped like a jagged sulfur-yellow fissure torn through basalt, thick charcoal outline, molten orange cracks glowing along its edges, a flat deep-amber shadow lip beneath it, screen-printed inks with halftone grain, completely blank empty centre, transparent background.

items.name: btn_secondary
items.prompt: A calm wide button plate cut from dark basalt with a chipped stone border and a thin sulfur-yellow underline, muted warm brown inks with halftone grain, flat screen-print styling, completely blank empty centre, transparent background.

items.name: icon_settings
items.prompt: A single basalt valve handwheel seen face-on, dark stone rim with sulfur-yellow spokes and a molten orange hub, thick charcoal outline, flat screen-printed inks with halftone grain, transparent background.

items.name: icon_info
items.prompt: A single carved stone tablet standing upright with three struck chisel marks across it, warm ash-grey stone with one mark inked molten orange, thick charcoal outline, flat screen-printed inks with halftone grain, transparent background.
